# Nuker

**Category:** World  
**Aliases:** Nuker

## What it does

Nuker automatically breaks blocks in your surrounding area without any manual clicking. When enabled, it continuously scans for valid blocks within range and destroys them one after another — useful for clearing terrain, farming resources, or demolishing structures rapidly. While target rendering is on, the highlight around the current block reflects how close it is to breaking. It pairs well with AutoTool to always use the most efficient tool for whatever it is breaking.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/world/nuker). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
